info.description: 1.55B multimodal embedding model. It embeds text and document images into a 2048-dimensional vector, with a 32,768-token context. The hosted Preview API serves the BF16 variant as nvidia/nemotron-3.5-embed-1b. Weights use OpenMDW-1.1. The same card also describes an NVFP4 quantized derivative that is not a separate hosted model id. The trial endpoint does not publish a numeric standard price.

zh.description: 1.55B 多模态向量模型。它把文本和文档图像编码为 2048 维向量，上下文 32,768 tokens。托管的 Preview API 提供 BF16 变体，模型 ID 为 nvidia/nemotron-3.5-embed-1b。权重使用 OpenMDW-1.1。同一模型卡还描述了 NVFP4 量化衍生版本，它不是另一个托管模型 ID。试用端点没有公布数字标准价。
